role: PROTOCOL_SAPGFS_FREEZE_v1 (2026-09-28): frozen BEFORE the 200-seed robustness benchmark; no acquisition/normalization/budget changes after seeing fault replay
surrogate: QSurrogate: ConstantKernel(0.2)*Matern(nu=1.5, per-dim length_scale) + WhiteKernel(0.02); sklearn GP, normalize_y=True, n_restarts_optimizer=2, random_state=0; features = one-hot(Y,X,Z) + normalized C,L
acquisition: MC-EHVI (n_samples=16 in replay); cost-aware variant divides by C_eval/Cmax; prefilter none (15 candidates)
normalization: objectives (Q, 1-C/Cmax, 1-L/Lmax) maximization, Cmax/Lmax = max over the CURRENT candidate set (G_collab, 15 configs)
reference_point: origin (0,0,0) for HV; regret normalized by HV(true front)
initial_design: 2 configs chosen uniformly at random, COMMON across all strategies within a seed (paired design)
noise_model: per-seed empirical Q (3 fault seeds, uniform draw) — real panel noise, no synthetic sigma
search_space: G_collab ONLY (15 cooperative configs); Single = external global baseline, never a search candidate; global vs collab always separate tables
metrics: Pareto recall — deduplicated by objective tuple (structurally identical configs counted once)
statistics: paired comparison (common init + common noise draw per seed), n_seeds=200; paired permutation test (10,000 sign shuffles) on final regret and AUC-HV for ehvi-vs-random, ehvi-vs-greedy, costaware-vs-random
frozen_before: the robustness run; any later change requires a new protocol version and full rerun
